race.comment: LOLLIE'S GALORE (2) has shown ability at times, and is bred to improve with more time. He drops down further in grade, and from a good draw, we have him on top. REGAL BANTER (10) needed her resuming run at Kilmore nearly 3 weeks ago over 1450m, and she will be a quick improver over a more suitable middle distance. Each way claims, especially after a 3kg claim. KHAN CAPITAL (1) did not have all the luck late when resuming at Coleraine just over 3 weeks ago, finishing fourth. Cam Rawiller picks up the ride, and he can figure in the top 3 this time. LADY COLONIST (6) has been crying out for more ground this prep, and she is fit enough to cope with a 7-day back up. Stick with her on an each-way basis. JULEP (5) had a few excuses last start, and has trialled since that run 4 weeks ago. Keep safe.
